title: Circuit Design Workshop
description: Hands-on workshop on PCB design and circuit simulation using industry-standard tools. Learn to design, simulate, and prototype your own circuits.

title: TechVista — Annual Technical Symposium
description: Our flagship annual event featuring paper presentations, project exhibitions, coding competitions, and guest lectures from industry leaders.

title: IoT Hackathon
description: 24-hour hackathon focused on building innovative IoT solutions for smart campus challenges. Form teams and compete for exciting prizes.

title: Embedded Systems Bootcamp
description: A 3-day intensive bootcamp covering ARM microcontrollers, RTOS fundamentals, and real-time embedded system design patterns.

title: Alumni Connect — Industry Insights
description: Interactive session with SAMARTHYA alumni working at top tech companies. Get insights into career paths, skill requirements, and industry trends.

title: Signal Processing Challenge
description: Competitive coding challenge focused on DSP algorithms, filter design, and real-time signal analysis. Test your skills against the best.
